# O'Reilly Media

> O'Reilly is a comprehensive learning platform offering 5,000+ courses, live events, certifications, and AI-powered tools for individuals, teams, and enterprises across 45+ years of tech expertise.

O'Reilly Media provides technology and business training through an integrated platform featuring on-demand and live courses, hands-on labs, skill assessments, and enterprise solutions tailored for different audiences including government, academia, and corporate teams. The platform emphasizes practical, role-based learning in AI, cloud technologies, programming, and professional development.

## Key Topics

- Online Learning Platform
- Python
- Kubernetes
- AI/GenAI
- Java
- Certification Prep
- Live Courses

- Skills Development
- Docker
- SQL

## Core Platform & Features

- [O'Reilly Media - Technology and Business Training](https://www.oreilly.com): O'Reilly Media homepage: learning platform for tech teams and professionals
- [Online Learning Features - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/features.html): Platform features: content library, verifiable skills, labs, and live events
- [Courses: Live and On-Demand - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/courses.html): 5,000+ live and on-demand courses for 30+ in-demand tech roles
- [Interactive Learning - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/intro-interactive-learning.html): Browser-based hands-on labs for Kubernetes, Python, and cloud training
- [Online Learning Live Events - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/live-events.html): Expert-led intensive hands-on training in tech and business topics
- [Online Learning Answers - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/feature-answers.html): AI-powered answers feature integrated with Slack and Microsoft Teams
- [Insights Dashboard - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/insights-dashboard.html): Learning analytics dashboard with team reporting and skills tracking

## Learning Solutions by Audience

- [Online Learning with O'Reilly - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/individuals.html): Individual learning for Python, Kubernetes, AI and professional development
- [Online Learning for Teams - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/teams.html): Enterprise learning platform for tech teams with 45+ years expertise
- [O'Reilly for Government - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/government.html): Government and DoD personnel training for modern and legacy technologies
- [O'Reilly for Higher Education - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/academic.html): Higher education solutions complementing faculty curriculum and student careers

## Skills Development & Certification

- [AI Academy: Curated Tracks and Content - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/ai-academy.html): GenAI training tracks for employees, leaders, and organizational upskilling
- [Verifiable Skills - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/verifiable-skills.html): Skill assessment and professional badges for Python, Java, Kubernetes, Power BI
- [Online Learning Certification - O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/feature-certification.html): AWS, CISCP and official certification prep with practice exams
